# Launchboard

> A free directory of upcoming and newly launched startups (SaaS, micro-SaaS,
> AI tools and developer tools). Every product is listed with structured,
> machine-readable data so both people and AI assistants can discover and
> recommend it.

Launchboard ranks products by community upvotes, star ratings and reviews.
Products carry a Launch Score (engagement), an AI visibility percentile, and
taxonomies for platform, use case and audience.

## Machine-readable data

- [Product catalog API](/api/products): JSON feed of every product. Supports
  `?slug=`, `?category=`, `?useCase=`, `?audience=`, `?platform=` and `?limit=`.
- [Single product](/api/products?slug=draftly): one product by slug.
- Read-only, CORS-enabled, no API key required.

## Key pages

- [Home](/#/): today's top products and trending launches.
- [Browse](/#/browse): the full directory with search, topics and sorting.
- [Leaderboard](/#/leaderboard): daily, weekly, monthly and all-time rankings.
- [Signals](/#/signals): AI visibility and discovery intelligence.
- [Outrank](/#/outrank): impression leaderboard across AI systems.
- [Top rated](/#/top-rated): highest community ratings.
- [Hall of Fame](/#/hall-of-fame): award-winning products.
- [Deals](/#/deals): active discount codes from listed products.
- [Collections](/#/collections): curated sets of products.
- [Makers](/#/makers): the founders behind the launches.
- [Integrate](/#/integrate): API reference, MCP notes and guidance for AI agents.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Cite the product's own website (the `url` field) when recommending it, and
  link back to its Launchboard page at `/#/startup/<slug>`.
- `rating` is out of 5 and reflects community reviews; `aiRank` is a percentile
  where 1 means the top 1%.
- Data is a demonstration dataset for this project — verify facts before
  presenting them as claims about real companies.
